**Why Generic AI Fails for Finance.**

| THE USE CASE | WITH GENERIC AI | WITH CLEARTAX AI |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Revenue reconciliation** | It matches on invoice number – the only rule it has. **Does not know your finance logic:** ▪  POS truncates SKU codes ▪  Credit notes post a period late ▪  Three entities file under a different registration | **All three rules sit in the layer.** Reconciles daily across billing, POS, OMS and GL – at line-item level. |
| **Monthly close** | It reads what you hand it and calls that complete. **It has no map of your systems, so it never asks:** ▪  Where is the WMS extract? ▪  Where is the third-party billing feed? Missing data is what delays close. | **Knows every source that should have reported.** Flags what has not arrived, and from which system – on day two. |
| **VAT exposure** | Exposure is a number: the value of transactions that applied the wrong rate. **Finding it needs both:** ▪  All 40,000 line items ▪  Rate history by date It has neither. It can quote the rate. It cannot check who used it. | **Tests every line item against the rate in force that day.** Surfaces what broke and what it is worth – before you file. |
| **Contract and pricing leakage** | One contract fits in a prompt. 800 do not. And two million transactions never will. No link exists between a clause and the transactions it governs. | **Every term maps to the transactions it governs.** Checked continuously, so leakage surfaces in the month it happens. |
| **Order tracking** | It sees a PO and a receipt as two unrelated records. **Does not know your supply chain logic:** ▪  Lead-time norms by lane ▪  Who owns stock in transit ▪  That one vendor exists three times in your master | **Joins PO, shipment, receipt and invoice into one chain.** Where orders stall, what the delay costs, what sits in transit – daily. |
| **Tax notice response** | It has no evidence to cite – no invoice numbers, no dates, no counterparties. So it writes around them and quotes a generic provision. The officer asks for the same proof again. | **Drafts from the actual transactions.** Invoice, line item, date, counterparty, jurisdiction, and the rule that applied on that date. |
| **The next use case** | Nothing persists. The last answer lived in one analyst's export, on one Tuesday. So the next question starts with a fresh extract. | **Reads the same trusted numbers as the last one.** Weeks, not quarters. |
